_note: PLACEHOLDER SAMPLE DATA. Operators, fares, schedules and times are invented for development and must be verified before release. Coordinates are approximate.

text.en: Bring a valid government ID
text.fil: Magdala ng valid na government ID

detail.en: The name on your ticket must match your ID. Students, seniors and PWDs: bring the ID that gives you a discount.
detail.fil: Dapat tugma ang pangalan sa tiket at sa ID. Mga estudyante, senior at PWD: dalhin ang ID para sa diskwento.

text.en: Bring cash in small bills
text.fil: Magdala ng baryang pera o maliliit na bill

detail.en: Tricycle and jeepney drivers often have no change for ₱500 or ₱1,000 bills.
detail.fil: Kadalasang walang panukli ang mga tricycle at jeep para sa ₱500 o ₱1,000.

text.en: Charge your phone and power bank
text.fil: I-charge ang cellphone at power bank

text.en: Save family contacts and the app's emergency numbers
text.fil: I-save ang numero ng pamilya at ang mga emergency number sa app

text.en: Pack motion sickness medicine if you get seasick
text.fil: Magdala ng gamot sa hilo kung nahihilo ka sa biyahe

detail.en: Take it about 30 minutes before boarding.
detail.fil: Inumin mga 30 minuto bago sumakay.

text.en: Pack a jacket, water and snacks
text.fil: Magdala ng jacket, tubig at baon

detail.en: Ship cabins can be cold at night.
detail.fil: Maaaring malamig sa loob ng barko sa gabi.

text.en: Check for weather or Coast Guard advisories before you leave
text.fil: Tingnan ang abiso ng panahon o ng Coast Guard bago umalis

detail.en: Trips are cancelled when the sea is rough. A cancelled trip is for your safety.
detail.fil: Kinakansela ang biyahe kapag malakas ang alon. Para sa inyong kaligtasan ang pagkansela.

text.en: Know where you will buy your ship ticket
text.fil: Alamin kung saan bibili ng tiket ng barko

detail.en: Buy only at the official ticket office or an authorized outlet, and keep the official receipt.
detail.fil: Bumili lamang sa opisyal na ticket office o awtorisadong outlet, at itago ang opisyal na resibo.

whatHappensNext.en: Next you will travel from your town to the pier.
whatHappensNext.fil: Susunod, bibiyahe ka mula sa inyong bayan papunta sa pantalan.

text.en: Agree on the fare before the ride if it is a special trip
text.fil: Pagkasunduan ang pamasahe bago sumakay kung special trip

whatHappensNext.en: At the pier you will pay the terminal fee and check in.
whatHappensNext.fil: Sa pantalan, magbabayad ka ng terminal fee at magche-check in.

text.en: Arrive early for check-in
text.fil: Dumating nang maaga para sa check-in

detail.en: Ships close check-in before departure. Late passengers are left behind.
detail.fil: Isinasara ang check-in bago umalis ang barko. Naiiwan ang mga nahuhuli.

text.en: Pay the terminal fee and keep the receipt
text.fil: Bayaran ang terminal fee at itago ang resibo

detail.en: You may be asked for it at the gate.
detail.fil: Maaaring hingin ito sa gate.

text.en: Check baggage rules with the shipping line
text.fil: Alamin ang patakaran sa bagahe ng shipping line

detail.en: Heavy or large bags may cost extra. Never carry flammables, fuel or sharp tools.
detail.fil: Maaaring may dagdag na bayad ang mabibigat o malalaking bag. Bawal magdala ng madaling magliyab, gasolina o matatalim na gamit.

text.en: Put your name and phone number on your bags
text.fil: Lagyan ng pangalan at numero ng telepono ang inyong mga bag

text.en: Listen for the boarding call and show your ticket and ID
text.fil: Makinig sa tawag para sumakay at ipakita ang tiket at ID

whatHappensNext.en: After boarding, the ship sails to the mainland port.
whatHappensNext.fil: Pagkasakay, maglalayag ang barko papunta sa pantalan sa Luzon.

text.en: Find your assigned seat or bunk
text.fil: Hanapin ang nakatalagang upuan o higaan

text.en: Find the life jackets and emergency exits
text.fil: Hanapin ang mga life jacket at emergency exit

detail.en: Watch the safety briefing.
detail.fil: Panoorin ang safety briefing.

text.en: Keep your phone, money and ID with you at all times
text.fil: Laging dala ang cellphone, pera at ID

whatHappensNext.en: When the ship docks, wait for the announcement before getting off.
whatHappensNext.fil: Pagdaong ng barko, hintayin ang anunsyo bago bumaba.

text.en: Ride only marked buses from the official terminal
text.fil: Sumakay lamang sa may markang bus mula sa opisyal na terminal

detail.en: Ignore people offering "faster" rides or asking for fees outside the terminal.
detail.fil: Huwag pansinin ang mga nag-aalok ng "mas mabilis" na sakay o humihingi ng bayad sa labas ng terminal.

text.en: Keep your bus ticket until you get off
text.fil: Itago ang tiket ng bus hanggang makababa

text.en: Tell the conductor where you will get off
text.fil: Sabihin sa konduktor kung saan ka bababa

whatHappensNext.en: The bus drops you at your stop in Metro Manila.
whatHappensNext.fil: Ibababa ka ng bus sa inyong hintuan sa Metro Manila.

text.en: Tell your family you arrived safely
text.fil: Ipaalam sa pamilya na ligtas kang nakarating

whatHappensNext.en: Ingat! Have a safe stay in Manila.
